comment: No source is published. What is above comes from the maker's manual, the panel artwork and the module's own port and parameter names. The 5 second delay, the 0.95 feedback ceiling, the 0.1 to 15 ratio range, the 24dB gain limits, the 1000Hz operator ceiling and the 20Hz to 12000Hz cutoff range are all fixed in the module. The filter cutoff jack is coloured as a pitch input because the cutoff is a frequency the same cables serve; the ratio and index jacks are plain CV. The panel prints the labels in lower case and marks the second operator's row by underlining its label, which is the only thing telling the two apart.
